'''Epinephrine''' was a chemical that could decrease the recovery time needed after fatigue. [[Adrenal implant/Legends|Adrenal implants]] stimulated the body's production of epinephrine.<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref>
